# TinyPivot

> In-Agent Analytics (MCP App) and lightweight React & Vue 3 data grid with free core charts & pivot tables, Pro unlimited rows, drill-through, read-only PostgreSQL, and Excel export.

TinyPivot is an **In-Agent Analytics MCP App** (`@smallwebco/tinypivot-mcp` — 1-command install via `npx @smallwebco/tinypivot-mcp@latest init` across Antigravity, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex CLI, and pi) and a batteries-included analytics DataGrid for Vue 3 and React. The MCP server streams CSV, TSV, JSON, inline MCP tool outputs, and read-only PostgreSQL results straight into an interactive Chart, Pivot Table, and Data Grid without stuffing raw rows into LLM context. Free includes core charts and basic pivot up to 2,500 rows (with explicit UI/LLM truncation banners); MCP Pro ($19/mo, $149/yr, or $399 local v1.x lifetime) and MCP Team ($79/mo or $699/yr for 5 seats) unlock unlimited rows, 10 themes, drill-through, Excel export, and read-only Postgres via dedicated TP-MCP* keys. UI Library perpetual licenses ($49–$399, TP-PRO* keys) remain separate for React & Vue web apps.

- [In-Agent Analytics (TinyPivot MCP Docs)](https://tiny-pivot.com/docs): Setup instructions for Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and CLI/PostgreSQL, plus MCP tool reference

- [Homepage](https://tiny-pivot.com): TinyPivot MCP overview, install command, and token savings
- [React & Vue library](https://tiny-pivot.com/ui): Live 10,000-row demo, quick start, and AI Data Analyst setup
- [Pricing](https://tiny-pivot.com/pricing): MCP plans and React/Vue one-time licenses
- [GitHub repository & README](https://github.com/Small-Web-Co/tinypivot): Source code, MCP server (`packages/mcp`), examples, and AI Analyst demo
